description: Global Hydropower Simulation - 21st century is a data set deposited in CUAHSI by its authors Sean Turner, Jia Yi Ng (Pacific Northwest National Laboratory). This resource contains the 21st century time series data for 1,593 hydropower dams, which collectively represent more than half of the world’s existing installed hydropower capacity (in 2016 when we conducted the study). Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 457744686 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is This resource is shared under the Creative Commons Attribution CC BY.. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
